transcript.text: Y'all know that I went on the radio in New York City and somebody asked me about Cody Rhodes
being QB1. You want to know what I said? I said you're carrying a weight that you can't
handle. I was wrong. You're just carrying it better than I ever could. This event is everything
you are, everything you stand for. I love you, bud. And I'm so glad to officially invite
you to the John Cena Classic.
